proposal.reason: Primary change is in network behavior: NET/CollNet/plugin selection and lifetime become per-communicator, and proxy progress/shutdown batching/control is reworked across net/proxy/transport network paths. communicator is also needed because comm init/split/free now own netName config, plugin retain/finalize pairing, and parent-child shared-resource backend compatibility checks. device-topology and graph-search are independently affected because topology/EIC and PXN/graph selection logic now uses communicator-selected backend state (e.g., useEic and per-comm net version) rather than process-global network state.
